name: UNCANNY
highlights: packaged UNCANNY scanner now resolves UNCANNY-InstallCommon.ps1 and UNCANNY-Library.ps1 from its runtime directory instead of the clean ZIP root
launcher cache and scan objects are canonicalized through safe property access before WPF binding, preventing legacy Path/Exe/schema records from emptying the library
official cropped silver UNCANNY U PNG is re-encoded through a 32-bit ARGB surface before WPF BitmapImage load, avoiding the tester-reproduced unrecognized image format failure
launcher logs include script stack and invocation position for recovered UI/cache/scan failures
process-scoped policy-independent UNCANNY.exe bootstrap from HF18.4 is preserved
persistent machine/user execution policy is not changed and Defender/SmartScreen are not disabled
updater hotfix serial parsing maps HF18.5 to 1850
installed-game/manual-library path hardening and stale-Lucid migration are preserved
Universal API Bridge, D3D11 native-Present stabilization, PCSX2, REVENANT, rollback, Motion Guard/Ghosting Guard and HF18 rendering behavior are preserved
validation: HF18.5 candidate; exact packaged cache/render/logo, real packaged scan invocation, normal startup, AllSigned startup, WARP, ZIP/hash and Defender gates required before publication.
